Film & Theatre

7:00 PM
Sun 26th Jul

venue

The Stein Auditorium

Book Now

NT Live Broadcast. The Playboy of the Western World (English/ 140 mins with interval) by John Millington Synge. Dir. Caitríona McLaughlin. Cast: Nicola Coughlan, Éanna Hardwicke, Siobhán McSweeney & others. Pegeen Flaherty’s life is turned upside down when a young man walks into her pub claiming that he’s killed his father. Instead of being shunned, the killer becomes a local hero and begins to win hearts, that is until a second man unexpectedly arrives on the scene. Tickets at Rs.500, Rs.350 & Rs.250 are available online on bookmyshow.com and at the Habitat Programmes desk.
